profile.headline: Unity Developer (15+ yrs) | VR/AR & Simulation | Gameplay & Combat Systems | Narrative Design | Networking/Multiplayer Experiences
profile.summary:
Unity Certified Developer with 15+ years building games and interactive systems — from narrative RPGs and turn-based combat to VR/AR simulation and cloud DevOps.

I started in game development working on multiplayer titles, narrative design, and a turn-based auto-battler with combat AI, targeting, and balance systems. More recently at Enludio and Unity's Government & Aerospace team, I've led engineering on VR training platforms, vehicle weapon system simulations, and AI-driven learning environments.

Core strengths: Unity3D/C# (15+ yrs), Unreal Engine, VR/AR (OpenXR, Meta SDKs), videogame design, narrative design, AWS cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, engineering leadership. Also experienced with Python, Node.js, MongoDB, Docker, and 3D Gaussian Splats for real-time visualization.

Looking for my next opportunity in game development, simulation/training, or immersive experience engineering. Open to roles in Orlando or remote.
